title: How I tested whether drawing a formation could turn a 300v300 fight
author: BeautifulSkill5804
selftext: I used an AI coding assistant to write a repeatable test around the existing ranked simulation. It searched for a case where a weaker lineup lost with default deployment and won against the same seeded opponent with five drawn squad orders. I replayed that seed at 60 simulation steps per second and captured it with the game renderer. Both sides started with 300 soldiers. The 220-power lineup beat 346 power with 124 soldiers left; the default formation lost. AI also helped script the capture and match the sound mix to combat events. Does the highlighted drawing path make it clear where the troops will go? The opponent is simulated.
